To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the efficiency of the heating system increases with the number of boilers in a system.
the efficiency of the heating system increases with the number of cascaded boilers and the heating efficiency is higher when the boilers are cascaded.
multiple boiler heating systems are more energy efficient compared to a single boiler system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a case study of a building heating system with multiple boilers.
the efficiency of cascading boilers in a heating system.
the following aspects: (i) heating system with multiple boilers, (ii) energy consumption and efficiency, (iii) building energy management, and (iv) building energy performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
multiple boilers are more efficient in heating than single boilers.
multiple boiler systems are more efficient than single boiler installations.
the efficiency of a heating system is increased with the number of cascaded boilers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the heating efficiency of a building can be increased by 15% if a multiple boiler system is installed instead of a single boiler installation.
multiple boilers are more energy efficient and more cost effective than a single boiler system.
the use of multiple cascading boilers is more efficient than a single boiler system and that the efficiency of a multiple boiler system is increased when the boilers are operated in parallel.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the efficiency increase is not linearly proportional with the number of boilers.
the heating efficiency of the system can be improved by installing more boilers.
multiple boilers can improve efficiency and reduce energy consumption, but the optimal number of boilers depends on the building size and the type of heating system.
